title: Filo Rial Race
paragraphs: The venue, to put it simply, is a dome-shaped building with an atmosphere similar to a sports stadium. I’m reminded of the times I used to enjoy various sports like baseball, soccer, and basketball with the pigs who had different hobbies back then. This place brings back memories of those venues. However, the crowd here has a rather intense atmosphere. I never went to a horse racing track before. Ah, but this feels a bit like a cycling race. I’ve been to one of those. One of the pigs had a hobby of that sort.
“The race is about to begin!”
Without buying any tickets, we watched the situation unfold from the spectator stands. The Filolials were being led around and shown off. If I recall correctly, this part is called the paddock.
“Hmm… they seem a little too excited. I wonder how that will affect the race…”

I can hear the commentator’s voice coming through the speakers. Judging from the tension and the condition of their bodies, I feel like numbers 3 and 6 will be the top contenders. By the way, I know that there are different types of Filolial races. This time, it seems to be a simple circuit race with jockeys riding on top. I’d also like to see an obstacle race someday.
“Wow, this is so exciting and fun!”
Kou’s eyes sparkled as he looked around. His body was fidgeting restlessly. He’s definitely being affected by the atmosphere of the venue. This is part of the thrill of the Filolial races.
“I’m curious to see what kind of contestants will be running.”

Yuki-chan was staring intently at the course. She didn’t seem interested in anything else. Indeed, Yuki-chan is a Filolial who is more focused on running. In fact, when it comes to pulling carriages, her interest is lower compared to other Filolials. Of course, since she’s a Filolial, it’s not that she dislikes pulling carriages. On the contrary, Sakura-chan, much like Filo-tan, enjoys pulling carriages. Apparently, this is a characteristic of the Filorialia species. A trumpet-like instrument sounded, and the Filolials entered the gates all at once. The gates closed. As soon as the flag was lowered, the doors of the gates flew open, and the Filolials dashed out, running at full speed.
“Oh…”
What an emotional sight. The Filolials are giving it their all, racing to be number one.
“…They’re a little slow, aren’t they?”
Yuki-chan seemed to be analyzing the situation.
“At that speed, Sakura would be faster… But if I’m going to enter, I’ll aim for first place!”

Yuki-chan’s rival is Sakura-chan. Sakura-chan is laid-back and rarely runs, but she’s fast enough to compete with Yuki-chan. That’s why Yuki-chan often asks Sakura-chan to race with her. As I predicted, the results were 3 and 6.
“What an enjoyable race!”
“The pacing, the way they run, the differences from pulling a carriage… There’s a lot to learn!”

According to Yuki-chan, there were many things to learn, like managing pace and performing steps she usually wouldn’t use while running. Just for that alone, it was worth coming here. That day, we watched race after race with intense focus. By the time evening came, I returned to the inn.
“Oh, welcome back, Motoyasu. How was it?”
“It was a very worthwhile race.”
“That’s great. I managed to learn the Meteor Shield.”
“This will make battles much easier.”
“Yeah. Based on my tests, it’s easy to use and quite convenient.”
Oh, it seems that even Father has mastered the traditional Meteor Shield. With the races included, today was an amazing day.
“Motoyasu, have you already eaten?”
“Not yet.”
“I’m hungry.”
“Yuki-chan, the breeder told you to watch your weight, though…”
“I can diet for the sake of the race!”
“Well, if there’s any issue, I can use magic to adjust the weight a little… I guess?”
“I want to do this fair and square!”
It seems there are quite a few complicated circumstances involved with Filolial races.
I’ll have to get the details from the breeder later! It’s such a fun place that it could become a lifelong passion.
“We were thinking of grabbing a bite to eat somewhere. Want to come, Motoyasu?”
“Of course!”
“Then let’s wait for Ren and Itsuki to get back before we go.”
“Understood!”
By the way, it seems that Ren, Itsuki, and Éclair went to watch the colosseum.
Maybe we should go check it out later? Just as I was thinking that, Ren and the others returned.
“We’re back.”
“Oh, Itsuki, Ren, and Éclair. How was the colosseum?”
“The duels between the mercenaries… It was quite an intense spectacle. It felt like watching a movie.”
“Yeah, just observing their techniques was interesting.”
Ren nodded in agreement with Itsuki.
“I’ve heard that mercenary martial arts tend to be rather crude, but that was an efficient fighting style in its own way. There’s a lot to learn from it.”
Éclair already has plenty of skill. Hearing about the style that makes use of energy boosts, it seems she’s working hard to master it.
“So, does everyone want to give it a try?”
“Itsuki would probably enter with a ring name like Perfect Hide Justice!”
“What’s with that embarrassing name?!”
What do you mean? I heard that was the ring name Itsuki used in his original world. Well, I never actually saw it myself, though.
“That’s what Father mumbled when he was mocking Itsuki in the first world, right? Something about the name he used at the colosseum.”
“Naofumi-san!?”
“Huh? How is this my fault!?”
Father shook his head, as if to say it was unfair. That’s right. It was just the foolish Itsuki who brought this upon himself.
“You’re talking about the time when Itsuki was acting like a clown. He’s different now, don’t worry about it.”
“…Understood. But seriously, that name is way too on the nose… I don’t even know what I was thinking.”
“Maybe you were drowning in your sense of justice?”
“Maybe… But it’s scary because I can actually see myself doing it.”
“By the way, Naofumi, did you find any relatives of Imiya?”
At Ren’s words, Father shook his head.
“Not at all… Apparently, situations like hers are pretty common in Zeltoble, so I couldn’t even find a lead in a day.”
“Would it be best to ask the country to arrange for someone knowledgeable?”
“Maybe. But I’ll figure something out, so Imiya, just wait a little longer, okay?”
“Y-Yes…”
The mole looked down as Father reassured her. Don’t worry. If Father puts his mind to it, nothing is impossible.
“Heh, Imiya really trusts Iwatani-dono, doesn’t she?”
Éclair murmured, looking pleased. The mole lowered her head even more.
“Eclair-san, don’t tease Imiya.”
“It was just a joke. Sorry, Imiya. Well then, shall we go eat?”
“Yeah, let’s go try some of Zeltoble’s famous dishes.”

With that lively mood, we all stepped out into the night streets of Zeltoble. Even at night, Zeltoble was full of life, so it didn’t feel strange for all of us to be walking together. The city was so diverse and bustling that it felt like a melting pot of different races.
“Where should we go?”
“Wouldn’t a more common place be better? Maybe somewhere with drinks.”
“Underage.”
“Naofumi-san, you’re so strict.”
“Yeah, exactly.”
Ren voiced his objection.
Is he that eager to drink?
“Naofumi-san, you don’t get drunk, right?”
“Yeah. That’s why I was often the organizer during drinking parties. Everyone ended up completely wasted most of the time.”
“I can see how that’s convenient, but it also sounds kind of sad.”
“That doesn’t mean I’m going to let you and Ren drink, though.”
“Nano! Gaelion wants to try alcohol. I heard that fine sake seeps into the body nicely, nano.”
When the rival said that, Father looked troubled and glanced toward the assistant.
“Dragons are heavy drinkers.”
“Hmm… But seeing you drink with that appearance is kind of…”
It’s easy to forget, but the rival is still in her young girl form, competing with Sakura-chan.
“Then I’ll transform into my dragon form later, nano!”
“What about Sakura?”
“Do Filolials even have a tendency to drink alcohol, Motoyasu?”
“I’ve never heard of such a thing.”
“Then it’s a no.”
“Alcohol?”
“Wait, you asked without knowing? Anyway, Sakura-chan, no drinking for you.”
“I hate that smell!”
Father almost stumbled. With a strained smile, Father said, “Then let’s have some fruit juice instead.” Hearing that, Sakura-chan was delighted.
Chapter 714 – Devotion
“Naofumi-san has it tough.”
“He’s basically a babysitter.”
“Don’t act like it’s not your problem. Why don’t you and Ren try taking care of a Filolial?”
Come to think of it, there are quite a few Filolials staying behind. For security reasons, they’re now stationed in various countries.
“Hmm, I don’t really like being in a group.”
“Stop trying to act cool. And why do you look a little embarrassed?”
“I’ll leave it to Motoyasu-san and Naofumi-san. I’ll just borrow one when I need to.”
“Depending on others like that isn’t good… haah.”
Ren and Itsuki looked away, trying to dodge Father’s sigh. That’s right. Ren and Itsuki don’t appreciate how wonderful Filolials are. As we were talking, we arrived at a large tavern.
“This is the tavern that the breeder recommended. Apparently, both the food and drinks are great. They have a wide variety, and it’s a favorite among mercenaries too.”
“Hmm…”
“Well, let’s go in and check it out.”
“Yeah.”
So, we went inside and enjoyed ordering whatever we liked. The breeder was right—everything was quite delicious.
“The local specialty dishes are pretty good too.”
“Indeed, just as Iwatani-dono said, the local sake is quite well-stocked.”
Since Éclair is an adult, she was sipping her drink leisurely. Plenty of food was served, enough to satisfy even the Filolials.
“YAHHAA!”
The tavern was lively with mercenaries making a ruckus.
But what does that phrase even mean?
“Are they mercenaries? Or maybe adventurers?”
“Probably. I heard that the Adventurer’s Guild holds a lot of power in this country, right?”
“Seems like it. I took a quick look, and they seem to have all kinds of jobs. As long as you have the skills, this country might be a pretty comfortable place to live.”
“But the security is bad, so we have to be careful. It feels like danger is just lurking around every corner in the back alleys.”
“I’ll strike them down!”
When I gripped my spear, Father and the others gave me slightly awkward looks. It’s the fault of the foolish thieves who dare to attack us.
“Well, they’d be bringing it upon themselves in that case.”
“Though, I’m not sure it’s worth killing over.”
“Still, this is the kind of country where finding corpses in back alleys is common, so even the Heroes should stay cautious.”
What is he saying to us heroes? With our current strength, this would be a walk in the park.
“Speaking of mercenaries… maybe it’s about time we start raising allies other than Filolials?”
“Hmm… like the kingdom’s soldiers?”
“That would be a reasonable choice. If the Heroes take the lead in training soldiers… wasn’t there a plan to boost the levels of some soldiers back during the Nosferatu Great Forest incident?”
“Oh yeah, I think that came up.”
“But… after being betrayed by allies within just a few days, I’m honestly a bit reluctant to recruit more.”
Ren answered with a bitter expression. Quite some time has passed since this loop started, but it seems the trauma still lingers.
“Yeah. In my case, from what I’ve heard from Motoyasu-san, I was killed or almost killed by my companions many times…”
“Hmm. Trustworthy companions… maybe it’s best to follow Father’s suggestion and stick to people Motoyasu-kun knew, like Éclair?”
At Father’s words, Ren and Itsuki turned their eyes toward me.
“Motoyasu-san, including the first world, what kind of companions did we have? Were there any trustworthy ones?”

Itsuki leaned forward and asked me. That’s right. I remember that all of Itsuki’s companions committed crimes and were executed. The only exception was that stalker pig. But since they’re asking me to include the first set of companions, I’ll answer honestly.
“Itsuki, is it? In my memory, aside from Smoked Meat and its followers, the only companion you had was that stalker pig. He stayed with you the whole time in Father’s village.”
“Stalker!?”
“Was he being held captive? No, wait… is this about the first world where Naofumi was managing the territory? So, Naofumi’s companion ended up taking care of Itsuki?”
I can still remember it vividly. The sight of Itsuki and the stalker pig sticking together all the time. Well, Itsuki was acting a little strange back then.

“Even in the previous loop, I think Itsuki brought him along. But I believe he was taken back home because of his bad reputation. After that, the Four Guardian Spirits were revived, so I’m not sure what happened after that.”
“Hmm…”
“So, a stalker was taking care of me? That’s a complete victory for the stalker, isn’t it…”
Itsuki slumped down in shock. I understand how he feels…
After all, I came to this world because of that selfish pig.
“Well, among the pigs, he was quite capable. He contributed enough as one of Father’s subordinates.”
“He was supposed to be my companion, but he ended up becoming Naofumi-san’s ally?”
“I talked to him before I awakened to love. It’s not an important story, but I remember a little of it.”

I explained the stalker pig’s situation to Itsuki. Apparently, Itsuki had saved him from a desperate situation, and he admired Itsuki’s sense of justice, which led him to become Itsuki’s companion. However, because his stats were inferior, he was reduced to doing errands and was eventually abandoned. Even then, he couldn’t give up and resorted to stalking. I was so scared of the stalker pig’s persistence that I pushed him onto Father.
“I don’t know what happened after that. But as I mentioned earlier, he was always with Itsuki in the village.”
Itsuki suddenly fell silent.
“Motoyasu-kun’s explanation is so bad that it’s hard to understand… but maybe that person had a lot of feelings for Itsuki?”

“Well, this is second-hand information, but I heard from the Filolials that it was the stalker pig who stopped Itsuki when he was consumed by the curse, believing that the opposite of justice is also justice.”
“So, to sum it up, he was cruelly abandoned by the Itsuki he trusted, ended up being taken in by Naofumi, stopped Itsuki when he went berserk, and then diligently took care of him?”
“…Wouldn’t that be called devotion, not stalking?”
“Where can I meet that person!? That’s my destined companion, isn’t it!?”
Itsuki grabbed me by the collar and shook me.
What’s this now? Is he really that interested?
“Wait a minute. You mentioned something about being saved from a desperate situation, right…?”
Itsuki is turning paler and paler.
“I don’t want to say this, but… maybe you should give up.”
“No way! It sounds like this person is my destined one!”
“So, Itsuki is interested in that kind of thing after all.”
“Motoyasu-san, please remember! Where did I meet this person, and what’s their name?”
Itsuki pressed me for answers with a serious look.
“May I ask as well, Kitamura-dono?”
Éclair backed him up.
Why is Éclair getting involved?
“Ah… if I recall correctly, Motoyasu-kun mentioned that Eclair-san died in prison and that her funeral was held around this time in the previous loop…”
“Hmm, perhaps that person is also in need of help. If that’s the case, we should act immediately.”
“You’re right. Motoyasu-kun, I’m asking you too. Do you remember the name of that person?”
“Well, let’s see…”
What was the name again? I retraced the words I had spoken back when I was still chasing after pigs before awakening to love…

Ah, I remember it now. It was something I said when I was soaking in the hot springs with Father and the others on Cal Mira Island. I remember talking about a beauty ranking. The crimson swine, the older sister, and Filo-tan were all nominated. And the stalker pig was the runner-up.
“Ah, I remember now. I think her name was Rishia.”
“Rishia… san.”
Itsuki repeated the name softly. That should be correct.
“But isn’t it going to be difficult to narrow it down with just the name Rishia?”

“Motoyasu-kun mentioned earlier that she was taken back to her family home, right? That means she’s probably from a good family. Depending on what kind of danger she was in, we might be able to narrow it down.”
“I see. With that information, we can start moving. We should search immediately. It might already be too late!”
“Yeah. Since Itsuki gathered his companions in Melromarc, that girl is probably in Melromarc too. Why don’t you ask the queen about it tomorrow?”
“…No, I’ll leave right away.”
“Will Kou run?”
Kou, who had been quietly eating his meal, spoke up to Itsuki.
Oh, is he going to help search for the stalker pig?
“Kou-san, can I ask for your help?”
“Leave it to me.”
Kou nodded in response to Itsuki’s request.
Kou… he’s become such a good boy…
At this rate, I doubt anyone would complain if he took a bite out of Itsuki’s hair.
